name: registry-views
about: LIVE walk of an installed app release on a network whose registry lists all 15 views (the six chrome views members/agents/node/explorer/settings/palette included; #109). Nothing wasm ships with the release, so every tab and the palette come off the network. WRITE-ONLY here: it joins a live network by a single-use invite and runs a member node. Everything runs in <out>/rig with no DUCKTAPE_VIEWS_DIR; teardown stops the app and the member node it started.

steps.expect: the Home tab is selected and its view shows; no failure state is visible (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading
